# Atom Shop Update 01/27/2026

![Atom Shop Update 01/27/2026](/uploads/632_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

### Free Yao Guai Carpet!

![FO76 YaoGuaiRug 4K 01](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/5rif2yngvIXtBKNqvLOYUh/02375a9b5a2022ee34affd6ef7ec9e5f/FO76_YaoGuaiRug_4K_01.png)

Fallout 76 is free to download and play! Celebrate with us by logging into Fallout 76 between January 27th and February 3rd and getting the Yao Guai Carpet from the Atomic Shop for free!

### Week commencing January 27th

#### Highlight offers

![Large SanctumoftheMoth copy](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/6ZRKaKvSf2vENNmE96RiPU/d59ed32cc70a92ba5b2e631fe2093f98/Large_SanctumoftheMoth_copy.png)

Starting January 27th, the Sanctuary of the Moth Pack will be available in the shop for a limited time!

Item Atoms Sanctuary of the Moth Pack 1,500 Life Laughter Mothman Pack 1,800 Mothman Wing Clipper Pack 840 (-30%) Weather Control Station (Mothman) 960 (-20%) Cultist Sanctuary C.A.M.P.
